results.title: How GAtrends works: sources and statistics
results.content:
Status
:   Learning: not enough data yet. Normal: close to usual. Rising: clearly above, for news from 1.5 times usual. Spike: above the alert line, for news from 3 times usual.

Every keyword has its own usual level in every source, so a small brand and a global one are each judged against themselves.

For alerts we go one step further where we can: news and Steam are compared with the same time of day on earlier days. A game that is always busy in the evening does not alert you every evening.

Alerts

## Quiet by design.

1

### A real jump

An alert needs a big ratio and a big absolute change together. Going from 1 article to 2 is +100%, but it is not a spike.

2

### No repeats [...] Speed by plan

## How often we check.

| Free | Starter | Pro | Business |
 ---  --- |
| Keywords | 3 | 15 | 75 | 300 |
| Google News | Hourly | Hourly | 15 min | 15 min |
| Hacker News, Steam | Hourly | Hourly | 30 min | 30 min |
| Google Trends, GitHub, Product Hunt | 15 min | 15 min | 15 min | 15 min |
| Wikipedia | 6 hours | 6 hours | 6 hours | 6 hours |
| Signal history | 5 latest, 7 days | 30 days | Full, about 13 months | Full, about 13 months |
| Telegram | 1 chat | 1 chat | 1 chat | 5 chats |
| Claude and ChatGPT connection, CSV export | No | No | Yes | Yes |
| Webhook, API, team seats | No | No | No | Yes, 5 seats |

Checks run in a queue, so a busy moment can add a few minutes.

See plansConnect Telegram, Claude or ChatGPT [...] 2

### No repeats

After an alert, the same thing stays quiet for a while. You are not pinged again about a story you already know.

3

### One signal, every channel

The same alert goes to your dashboard log and to Telegram. Business can also send it to a webhook, and Pro and Business can ask Claude or ChatGPT about it.

### Quiet periods

|  |  |
 --- |
| Google News, Steam | At most one alert per keyword every 3 hours |
| Google Trends | Once a day per trending topic |
| Wikipedia | Once per day of data |
| Hacker News | Once per story |
| GitHub, Product Hunt | Once per repository or launch |
